title: Senior Product Manager I (Remote Eligible)
description:
Headquarters: -REMOTE, USA-
 For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.
 We are looking to hire a Sr. Product Manager I to join our Product Organization. You will be accountable for driving business impacting investments within areas of high ambiguity, driving strategy that aligns with customer demands, business goals, and industry trends. Join us and help our customers leverage the potential of their workforce and mobilize their talent. In this role you will focus on the Admin and Billing experience,  the capabilities enterprise IT teams, administrators, and billing owners rely on to manage users, licenses, access, governance, and their commercial relationship with Smartsheet.
 You will report to our Director, Product Management located in our Boston, MA office. You may work remotely from anywhere in the US where Smartsheet is a registered employer.
 You Will: 
 Define a vision and strategy informed by company objectives, a deep understanding of customer needs, and industry best practices
 Partner with and influence technical and product leaders across Smartsheet to align strategy and platform investments
 Deeply understand how customers buy, provision, and manage their subscriptions, including plan and license entitlements, self-serve purchase and upgrade flows, renewals, invoicing, and usage visibility
 Work closely with Product Marketing, Sales, and Pricing and Packaging teams to position our Admin and Billing capabilities to IT and finance stakeholders, creating a strong go-to-market strategy
 Evaluate where AI can meaningfully improve the customer experience in new and existing features, making deliberate calls about how to apply it, how to earn administrator trust, and how to handle accuracy, transparency, and user control in workflows where precision matters
 Use AI tools to augment your own work (research synthesis, prototyping, analysis, and documentation) and identify opportunities to automate manual processes across the product development lifecycle
 Regularly present strategy, product concepts and roadmap to educate, influence and align with senior leadership
 Partner closely with research, design and engineering to create compelling, high-quality customer experiences
 Use internal and external data to guide experimentation, decisions, opportunities and evaluation of success
 Partner with research, product design, data science and analytics teams to run quantitative experiments and analysis to test hypotheses and iteratively develop product capabilities that our customers love
 Communicate strategy, product health, capabilities, experimentation status, and insights to a wide audience
 Write succinct and compelling product  strategy, execution and requirements documents
 Successful candidates will operate at both the strategic and tactical levels and form strong cross-team partnerships that ensure combined success for the product area
 Support other duties as needed
 You Have: 
 5+ years of product management experience
 Experience partnering closely with engineering, design, user research and marketing teams. Successfully delivered a delightful user experience with high-scale platforms
 Passion to make customers and colleagues successful and pride in creating delightful customer experiences with high-scale platforms
 Data-driven mentality with a focus on metrics, analytics and experimentation
 Experience with agile development processes and frequent product releases
 Strong presentation skills to influence and align with senior management
 Experience delivering highly-complex consumer or B2B/enterprise software products from inception to launch
 Experience with agile development processes and frequent product releases
 Comfort using AI tools to augment your day-to-day work, and a bias toward automating manual and
 repetitive processes
 Sound judgment about when and how to incorporate AI into product features to enhance the customer
 experience, including recognizing where deterministic, predictable behavior serves the customer better
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills
 High interpersonal skills to build trusted and strategic cross-team partnerships rooted in customer benefit
 Technical degree, or equivalent experience working with engineers to make product decisions on behalf of customers
 Current US Perks & Benefits: 
 Employer subsidized medical/vision and dental coverage for full-time employees
 401k Match to help you save for your future (50% of your contribution up to the first 6% of your eligible pay)
 Monthly stipend to support your work and productivity
 Flexible Time Away Program, plus Sick Time Off
 US employees are automatically covered under Smartsheet-sponsored life insurance, short-term, and long-term disability plans
 US employees receive 12 paid holidays per year
 Up to 24 weeks of Parental Leave
 Personal paid Volunteer Day to support our community
 Opportunities for professional growth and development including access to Udemy online courses
 Company Funded Perks, including a counseling membership, local retail discounts, and your own personal Smartsheet account
 Teleworking options from any registered location in the U.S. (role specific)
 Smartsheet provides a competitive base salary range for roles that may be hired in different geographic areas we are licensed to operate our business from. Actual compensation is determined by several factors including, but not limited to, level of professional, educational experience, skills, and specific candidate location. In addition, this role will be eligible for a market competitive incentive opp

title: Product Manager - Platform
description:
Headquarters: Remote US
 Product Manager - Platform  
 Bitwarden empowers enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely store and share sensitive data. With a transparent, open-source approach to password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations, Bitwarden makes it easy for users to extend robust security practices across all online activities. Founded in 2016 with headquarters in Santa Barbara, California, Bitwarden is supported by a passionate global community of security experts and enthusiasts. 
 As Product Manager, Platform at Bitwarden, you will own the strategy and execution for deployment optionality: the shared capabilities that let Bitwarden behave consistently and securely whether a customer uses our cloud, a regional or government cloud, or their own servers. You will be meticulous about how each Bitwarden app connects to and is configured for the right place, and about which behaviors are allowed to differ by setup, such as federal security standards (FedRAMP, FIPS), IT-managed device settings, and self-hosting constraints. You will partner with Engineering, Architecture, BRE, SRE, Security, and Design to turn initiatives into clear, shippable outcomes for product teams and customers. You will partner with Sales, Solutions Engineering, and Implementation Engineering on how deployment flexibility wins public sector, regulated, and large enterprise deals, and how it meets their compliance requirements. You will use customer feedback, deployment and upgrade data, and competitive benchmarking to inform roadmap decisions, thinking deeply about both the self-hosted operator and the cloud customer.
 This is an all-remote team and we’re looking for someone located in the U.S. with no preference for time zone. We do not offer visa sponsorship at this time. 
 RESPONSIBILITIES   
 Own the roadmap for the shared capabilities that let Bitwarden run across cloud, government cloud, and self-hosted setups, including how each app connects to and is configured for the right context
 Define what stays the same and what is allowed to differ by setup, and document those decisions so product teams build to them
 Research, design and proposed professional services offerings that support customers with special deployment requirements, across cloud, government cloud, and self-hosted setups
 Drive cross-team initiatives such as the FedRAMP-compliant cloud and the move to a service oriented architecture, keeping scope, sequencing, and dependencies clear across Engineering, SRE, and product teams
 Analyze how competitive and adjacent password and identity vendors approach government, regulated, and self-hosted deployments, refine our competitive edge
 Model the relationship between deployment options and public sector wins, enterprise deal velocity, expansion ARR, and retention
 Define and monitor adoption metrics, such as customers by deployment type, upgrade success and lag, and feature parity gaps between setups
 Support Sales, Solutions Engineering, and Implementation Engineering on how deployment options map to customer compliance requirements, including RFP responses and deal-stage conversations
 Share progress, roadmap updates, and wins with leadership and cross-functional partners
 Use AI tools to accelerate spec writing, competitive analysis, data modeling, and rapid prototyping
 WHAT YOU BRING TO BITWARDEN  
 2+ years experience in product management 
 Experience with platform features of B2B SaaS products
 Experience working with US Federal Government customers
 Strong technical aptitude with a focus on authentication architectures and the software deployment lifecycle
 Ability to translate complex security concepts into intuitive admin experiences 
 Ability to have technical discussions with engineering and architecture and technology tradeoffs 
 Extremely organized and able to make highly informed prioritization & trade-off decisions with engineering 
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills 
 A growth mindset and a desire to learn from others 
 Excitement and enthusiasm for open source and for better internet security 
 WHAT TO EXPECT IN THE INTERVIEW PROCESS  
 Selected candidates will be invited to schedule an introduction call and potentially progress through the following stages: 
 Interview with Director, Product Management 
 Interview with Chief Product Officer 
 Interview with Chief Technology Officer 
 Reference calls 
 A FEW REASONS TO WORK WITH US  
 Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world’s largest organizations. Become an expert. You’ll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software. We are dedicated to building a diverse and talented team. Work remotely with motivated and supportive team members across the world.
 In the United States, the starting base compensation range for this role is $150,000 - $160,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, relevant experience, and skill set as assessed in the interview process, as well as market data by location. See our careers page for a list of benefits. Please note that compensation outside the U.S. will differ based on the market. 
 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/bitwarden-product-manager-platform

title: Product Manager
description:
**Our mission is to enable everyone to build wealth**
-----------------------------------------------------
We reinvent how trading and investing work by creating exceptional products people love. Fostering a culture of excellence and high velocity is the key to our success. Тoday, we serve over 6 million clients, with more than €38 billion in assets under management — a testament to the scale and trust we’ve built in just a few years.
**The role**
------------
You'll own a set of features inside a product area and work with a Senior Product Manager while you learn the business. Our teams cover trading and execution (order routing, settlement, corporate actions), tax-efficient investing and pensions (ISAs, SIPPs and German pension accounts), crypto, and client accounts and payments (onboarding, client money, cards and FX). You work directly with engineers and designers.
**What you'll do**
------------------
* Prioritise your features with your manager, from client needs, product data and commercial goals
* Read the regulation, the API documentation and the operational process yourself, and bring a position to your Senior PM before Legal and Compliance review it
* Write the spec: client journey, business rules, data, integrations and acceptance criteria, detailed enough to build and test from
* Carry your decisions through delivery with Engineering, Design, Legal, Compliance and Operations, with senior support when you need it
* Take your features through testing and launch, then run them: monitoring, client feedback, the numbers, the next improvement
**What you need to have**
-------------------------
* A product or a set of features you shipped yourself and can walk through in detail, including where it broke: a rounding rule, a time zone, a rule you got wrong, an API that changed under you
* Enough technical understanding to read documentation, follow a data flow and reason about system behaviour with engineers
* Your own numbers: you query the data yourself and can explain every figure you quote
* Evidence of regular use of AI in product work, including best practices
**What we offer:**
------------------
* Real ownership from day one: your features, your spec, your launch, with a Senior Product Manager behind you
* A co-founder in your interview loop and in your work
* Challenges that will help you grow and realize your potential fast
* Opportunity to make a significant impact —you will build innovative services used by millions of investors to build wealth
* Work with smart, spirited, helpful, high-performing colleagues with a common goal
* An environment where nothing is set in stone
* Appreciation for your talent and ideas
* Generous remuneration package
**Bring your ambition to Europe’s fastest-growing mobile broker!** 
*We thank all applicants, but only candidates selected for interview will be contacted. All personal data of applicants is protected by law and treated with strict confidentiality.*

title: Senior Product Manager (Customer Agent Team) Berlin
description:
Fin, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.
Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.
Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.
Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
We’re looking for a **Senior Product Manager** to join our team and help shape the future of business messaging and AI-powered customer engagement. This is a career-defining opportunity to lead a world-class team of engineers, designers, and researchers to deliver products that touch millions of people every day.
**What will I be doing?**
-------------------------
* Be responsible for a significant product area or leading an important project.
* Deeply understand the customer problems you’re tackling through research, data, and direct customer interactions — then frame those problems clearly for your team.
* Manage the roadmap; defining what should be built, when and why - and communicate it to generate alignment and excitement.
* Collaborate with engineers and designers to imagine, build, and ship solutions, from bold future visions to small, focused iterations.
* Leverage AI to increase your own efficiency, accelerate product development, and multiply your team’s impact.
* Evaluate impact through quantitative and qualitative measures, both in beta and after full release.
* Own and maintain the quality of your product area, ensuring every release delivers world-class software.
* Collaborate with peers across the business to ensure we deliver products with clear GTM strategy and execution, getting hands on wherever necessary to ensure we deliver.
* Be a leader in your team or projects by role-modelling our company values and R&D principles.

--------------------------
There is no minimum years of experience for this role. We’re interested in your impact, drive, and potential. Instead of years, we’ll be looking for evidence that you’ve applied and grown these skills:
* **Sharp Customer Focus & Problem Framing -** able to independently understand, define and articulate complex customer problems and opportunities using data analysis and qualitative inputs.
* **Compelling Roadmaps -** define the roadmap of features, products or areas of focus for your given area, communicating what, when and why to generate excitement with customers and the team
* **Excellent Product Judgment -** skilled at balancing customer needs, business impact, and technical constraints to define, advocate for, and deliver the right product.
* **Build World-Class Product -** able to deeply collaborate with engineering and designers to quickly ship effective solutions. But, also able to independently accelerate the process leveraging AI.
* **AI Tech -** Able to understand AI systems and LLMs, assess feasibility and trade-offs, and make informed product decisions in close collaboration with engineering.
* **Technical fluency -** Comfortable engaging with engineers and customers on the modern tech stack — from APIs and SaaS infrastructure to low-code tooling and system architecture.
* **Outcome Oriented -** define, fight for and share progress against the customer and business impact of your product area or project. Leadership - Excellent communicator. High ownership. Ability to influence and drive alignment.

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

title: Senior Product Manager – Cloud & AI Platform (m/f/d) - Berlin
description:
At Maddox AI, our vision AI inspects products on production lines across Germany, Europe, the U.S. and Asia, in automotive, energy, electronics and medtech. The stakes are high: a missed defect ends up in a car, a power grid or a medical device, and a failing model stops an entire line. Catching defects early saves our customers complaints and scrap and maximizes yield. And we put this AI directly in the hands of quality engineers and shop floor workers, who train their own inspection models without being AI experts.
We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to drive this platform forward. You'll work directly with our co-founder & CTO, product engineers, AI engineers and UX designers. Expect a lot of ownership and to stay close to the details.
**What you'll do**
------------------
* Drive the roadmap of the vision AI and yield platform, from synthetic defect generation and AI-assisted image annotation to edge deployment, production monitoring and AI agents.
* Stay close to our forward-deployed and customer success engineers: check in proactively, jump in when something is on fire, and turn their input into prioritized work. Say no to the loudest request when it isn't the most important one.
* Track competitors and the market, and bring feature ideas before anyone asks.
* Partner with design to turn complex vision AI capabilities into UX that quality engineers grasp and use without ML expertise.
* Prototype instead of writing long specs: clickable prototypes, automations and internal dashboards built with AI tools.
* Dig into usage data and turn what you learn into clear decisions.
**What we're looking for**
--------------------------
* 4+ years of experience in B2B SaaS, working on AI, data or industrial products.
* A technical background, e.g. a degree in computer science or software engineering, or equivalent hands-on experience. You discuss architecture, APIs and trade-offs with engineers as a peer.
* Strong product and UX taste: you spot instantly where a workflow gets too complicated and find ways to simplify it.
* You build with AI tools every day. You don't need to write production code.
* Drive and pragmatism: you decide with incomplete information and know when good enough should ship.
* Fluent English; German is a strong plus, since many of our customers are German manufacturers.
* 3 days a week in our Berlin office
**Why Maddox AI**
-----------------
* Real ownership of an AI product running in production at leading manufacturers worldwide
* Small team, short decision paths, direct line to the founders
* Co-founded with Cyber Valley computer vision researchers Prof. Matthias Bethge, Prof. Alexander Ecker and Dr. Wieland Brendel
* Competitive salary, virtual shares (VSOP), 30 vacation days and a yearly learning budget
* Hybrid work from our office in Berlin
Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. We welcome applications regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic or social background, disability, sexual orientation or identity.

title: Product Owner/Delivery Lead - System Integration
description:
**Company Description**
Founded and headquartered in Switzerland, Avaloq is continuously expanding its global footprint with around 2,500 colleagues in 10 countries, and more than 160 clients in 35 countries. We are an industry-leading provider of wealth management technology and services for financial institutions around the world, including private banks and wealth managers, investment managers, as well as retail and neo banks. Our research led approach and continual innovation is powered by the passion and creativity of our colleagues.
We are always looking for talented people to join us on our mission to orchestrate the financial ecosystem and democratize access to wealth management. Avaloq offers the opportunity to work closely with some of the world’s leading financial institutions as we jointly develop and shape careers. Championing a collaborative, supportive and flexible work environment empowers our colleagues to reach their full potential.
 **Job Description**
As a Product Owner/Delivery Lead - System Integration, you will assume full accountability for complex and high-impact changes, directing cross-functional team execution while establishing and maintaining rigorous delivery discipline, quality standards, and predictability across the Standing Team.
* Assume full ownership of transversal change delivery for FinTS, interfaces, output, static data, access management, mappings and upstream/downstream dependencies ensuring comprehensive evidence coordination throughout all delivery stages
* Translate approved solutions into clearly defined epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and detailed delivery plans
* Maintain complete accountability for scope definition, assumptions, estimates, dependencies, risk identification, decision documentation, and progress transparency
* Direct coordination of developers, testers, and specialized resources to ensure prompt resolution of delivery impediments and maintain schedule adherence
* Safeguard agreed scope parameters and ensure all scope modifications or additions are documented transparently and processed through established change management protocols
* Verify completion of all test evidence, technical documentation, release tasks, handover materials, and go-live readiness requirements
* Maintain rigorous stakeholder communication protocols and provide critical support during go-live execution
**Qualifications** 
* Advanced change-delivery, requirements and stakeholder-management capability
* Practical Avaloq Banking Suite experience
* Experience in a customer-facing banking delivery role
* Ability to steer changes independently and make delivery trade-offs within assigned authority
* Experience with Agile delivery, testing, release preparation and controlled documentation
* Fluent German and English communication skills
It would be a real bonus if you have
* Knowledge of Jira, Confluence and release governance
* Regulated banking delivery experience
**Additional Information**
We realize that managing work life balance is a challenge we all face in our daily lives and in order to support with this we are pleased to offer hybrid and flexible working for most of our Avaloqers to maintain work life balance and still continue our fantastic Avaloq culture in our global offices.
In Avaloq we are proud to embrace diversity and understand the success of our business is built on the power of different opinions, we are whole heartedly committed to fostering an equal opportunity environment and inclusive culture where you can be your true authentic self.
We hire, compensate and promote regardless of origin, age, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other fantastic traits that make us all unique, we have done our best to write this advert in an inclusive and neutral way.
Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations.

Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.
Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.
Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our team and help shape the future of business messaging and AI-powered customer engagement. This is a career-defining opportunity to lead a world-class team of engineers, designers, and researchers to deliver products that touch millions of people every day.
 What will I be doing?
 Be responsible for a significant product area or leading an important project.
 Deeply understand the customer problems you’re tackling through research, data, and direct customer interactions — then frame those problems clearly for your team.
 Manage the roadmap; defining what should be built, when and why - and communicate it to generate alignment and excitement. 
 Collaborate with engineers and designers to imagine, build, and ship solutions, from bold future visions to small, focused iterations.
 Leverage AI to increase your own efficiency, accelerate product development, and multiply your team’s impact. 
 Evaluate impact through quantitative and qualitative measures, both in beta and after full release.
 Own and maintain the quality of your product area, ensuring every release delivers world-class software.
 Collaborate with peers across the business to ensure we deliver products with clear GTM strategy and execution, getting hands on wherever necessary to ensure we deliver. 
 Be a leader in your team or projects by role-modelling our company values and R&D principles. 
 What skills do I need?
 Skills
 There is no minimum years of experience for this role. We’re interested in your impact, drive, and potential. Instead of years, we’ll be looking for evidence that you’ve applied and grown these skills:
 Sharp Customer Focus & Problem Framing - able to independently understand, define and articulate complex customer problems and opportunities using data analysis and qualitative inputs. 
 Compelling Roadmaps - define the roadmap of features, products or areas of focus for your given area, communicating what, when and why to generate excitement with customers and the team
 Excellent Product Judgment - skilled at balancing customer needs, business impact, and technical constraints to define, advocate for, and deliver the right product.
 Build World-Class Product - able to deeply collaborate with engineering and designers to quickly ship effective solutions. But, also able to independently accelerate the process leveraging AI.
 AI Tech - Able to understand AI systems and LLMs, assess feasibility and trade-offs, and make informed product decisions in close collaboration with engineering.
 Technical fluency - Comfortable engaging with engineers and customers on the modern tech stack — from APIs and SaaS infrastructure to low-code tooling and system architecture.
 Outcome Oriented - define, fight for and share progress against the customer and business impact of your product area or project. Leadership - Excellent communicator. High ownership. Ability to influence and drive alignment. 
 Unleash Your Potential
 When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. At Fin, we want to give people what they need to do the best work of their careers. Our benefits and programs are designed to support your health and wellbeing, your family, your time away from work, and your financial future. Offerings vary by location in line with local practices and requirements. Learn more about working at Fin and the benefits we offer at fin.ai/careers. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.
 Policies 
 Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week.
We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. title: Founders Associate (m/w/d)
description:
Ralph baut das Operating System für Wohnimmobilien. Der Markt ist riesig, und er läuft noch größtenteils auf Aktenordnern, Outlook und USB-Sticks. Wir sind der erste AI Property Manager, der auf einem eigenen Operating System läuft, und betreiben Gebäude damit End-to-End. Ralph OS automatisiert Zahlungen, Buchhaltung, Compliance und Kommunikation. AI-Agenten bereiten die Arbeit vor, und unser Team gibt sie frei. Die Hausverwaltung ist unser Einstieg. Das Ziel ist die neue Infrastruktur für die ganze Kategorie, mit Fintech, Versicherung und Finanzierung auf derselben Plattform. Heute verwalten wir über 10.000 Wohneinheiten und wachsen schnell, organisch und durch Zukäufe. Verantwortung bekommst du bei uns früh, und was du baust, nutzen wir direkt im Alltag.
**Deine Rolle**
---------------
Die Verwaltung rund ums Zuhause ist oft frustrierend. Ralph macht Wohnen einfacher, effizienter und digital: ein echtes "Home in your Pocket". Damit das auch beim schnellen Wachstum gelingt, brauchst du als Founders Associate gemeinsam mit unserem VP Operations dafür zu sorgen, dass neu erworbene Unternehmen sauber integriert und operativ auf Ralph-Standard gebracht werden. Du baust Playbooks, Standards und Automatisierungen, die Ralphs Wachstum in den nächsten Jahren prägen, und arbeitest dabei mit tiefem Einblick in zentrale Management-, Integrations- und Transformationsfragen eng am Executive Leadership Team.
**Deine Aufgaben**
------------------
* **Integration & Transformation:** Du arbeitest eng mit dem VP Operations daran, neu erworbene Unternehmen sauber zu integrieren und operativ auf Ralph-Standard zu bringen.
* **Process Design:** Du entwickelst Playbooks, Standards, Eskalationslogiken und Entscheidungsroutinen für wiederkehrende operative Situationen.
* **Automation:** Du identifizierst manuelle, fehleranfällige Abläufe und erarbeitest mit Product, Tech und Operations bessere, automatisierte Lösungen.
* **People & Change:** Du begleitest neue Arbeitsweisen, schärfst Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten und stellst sicher, dass Veränderungen im Team im Alltag ankommen.
* **Execution & Escalation:** Du übernimmst wichtige Transformationsprojekte mit direktem Einfluss auf Effizienz, Qualität und Kundenzufriedenheit, springst bei komplexen operativen Themen ein, strukturierst Sachverhalte und übersetzt sie in konkrete nächste Schritte. Dir ist kein Problem zu groß oder zu klein: Du übernimmst Ownership und bleibst dran, bis es gelöst ist.
* Enge Zusammenarbeit mit VP Operations, Product, Tech und dem Executive Leadership Team und Input zur Verbesserung unserer Prozesse und Software
**Das bringst du mit**
----------------------
* Entrepreneurial Spirit: Du willst verstehen, wie man ein Unternehmen operativ besser macht, und hast keine Berührungsängste, selbst hands-on einzusteigen.
* Change Mindset: Du verstehst, dass gute Prozesse nicht nur gebaut, sondern erklärt, eingeführt und im Alltag verankert werden müssen.
* Analytische Schärfe: Du liebst Daten und komplexe Zusammenhänge und kannst sie in einfache, umsetzbare Prozesse übersetzen.
* Execution Power: Du hast einen extremen Drang zum Machen. Wenn du eine Mauer siehst, suchst du den Weg darüber hinweg.
* Strukturierte Arbeitsweise, hohe Verbindlichkeit und Eigenverantwortung
* Starkes Kommunikationsvermögen und Offenheit für neue Herausforderungen und digitale Tools. Du trittst auch in anspruchsvollen Situationen souverän auf.
* **Deutsch:** C2
**Das bieten wir**
------------------
* Modernes Setup: MacBook, iPhone und moderne Tools von Tag eins
* Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten ohne Mikromanagement
* Hybrides Arbeiten mit klar geregelten Bürotagen (2 Tage im Büro)
* Urban Sports Club Zuschuss
* Regelmäßige Team-Events, Team-Lunches und Getränke im Büro
* Unterstützung bei deiner Weiterentwicklung: Bei starker Performance wächst du in 12 bis 18 Monaten in eine zentrale Operations-Rolle hinein, z. B. als Operations Lead, Head of PMI oder Head of Operations.
**Bewerbungsprozess**
---------------------
* Intro Call (ca. 30 Min.) mit Recruiting
* Fachgespräch (ca. 30 Min.)
* Fachgespräch und Fallstudie
* Finales Gespräch mit der Geschäftsführung
* Angebot
**Eckdaten**
------------
* **Standort:** Berlin
* **Anstellungsart:** Angestellte/r
* **Arbeitszeit:** Vollzeit, 40 h/Woche
* **Arbeitsmodell:** Hybrid
* **Büroregelung:** 2 Tage pro Woche im Büro in Berlin, Rest remote
* **Berichtet an:** VP Operations
Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von allen, unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Herkunft, Religion, Behinderung oder sexueller Identität.

title: Product Owner Risikosysteme - Banksteuerung (m/w/d)
description:
**S-Kreditpartner – unser Name ist Programm. Und der macht auf den ersten Blick deutlich: Wir gehören zur Familie der Sparkassen. Als spezialisierter Verbundpartner bündeln wir die Aktivitäten für die Auto- und Konsumentenfinanzierung. Gemeinsam mit unseren Vertriebspartnern wollen wir die Position der Sparkassen-Finanzgruppe in diesen Geschäftsfeldern stärken.**
Als Product Owner Risikosysteme - Banksteuerung (m/w/d) gestaltest Du die Risikosteuerung aktiv mit und entwickelst unsere Risikosysteme operativ und strategisch weiter. Du verantwortest Produktvision und Roadmap, priorisierst unterschiedliche Anforderungen und übersetzt sie gemeinsam mit interdisziplinären Teams in tragfähige Lösungen. Dabei behältst Du die Qualität der Risikodaten sowie die Weiterentwicklung von Risikoreports und Kennzahlen-Cockpits stets im Blick - und leistest so einen direkten Beitrag zu einer effizienten und zukunftsorientierten Risikosteuerung. Klingt spannend!? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt als
**Product Owner Risikosysteme - Banksteuerung (m/w/d)**
=======================================================
**Deine Aufgaben**
------------------
* Operative und strategische Weiterentwicklung unserer Risikosysteme sowie Definition und Abstimmung von Produktvision und Roadmap
* Aufnahme, Bewertung und Priorisierung fachlicher, technischer und regulatorischer Anforderungen sowie Pflege eines transparenten Product Backlogs
* Enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Stakeholdern zur Entwicklung passender Lösungen und Abstimmung von Prioritäten
* Übersetzung fachlicher Anforderungen in User Stories und Abnahmekriterien sowie Begleitung der Umsetzung gemeinsam mit interdisziplinären Teams
* Koordination und Begleitung von System- und Integrationstests sowie Verantwortung für die fachliche Abnahme neuer Funktionen
* Weiterentwicklung von Auswertungen und Reportingstrukturen im Umfeld der Risikosysteme, beispielsweise Risikoreports, Dashboards und Kennzahlen-Cockpits
* Mitwirkung an der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von Datenqualität, Schnittstellen und Prozessen in enger Abstimmung mit den verantwortlichen Einheiten
* Transparente Kommunikation von Produktentscheidungen, Abhängigkeiten und Fortschritten an Fachbereiche, IT und Management
**Dein Profil**
---------------
* Abgeschlossenes Studium mit mathematischem oder informationstechnischem Schwerpunkt oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
* Mehrjährige Erfahrung in einer vergleichbaren Rolle mit Steuerung und Weiterentwicklung komplexer IT-Systeme in einer Bank oder im Bankenumfeld
* Gutes Verständnis von Risikomanagement, Banksteuerung und Risikokennzahlen sowie Kenntnisse relevanter regulatorischer Anforderungen
* Erfahrung im Umgang mit relationalen Datenbanken und Datenmodellen sowie fundierte SQL-Kenntnisse zur Analyse und Auswertung von Daten
* Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Produktvisionen und Roadmaps, der Priorisierung von Backlogs und der Zusammenarbeit mit interdisziplinären Teams
* Gutes technisches Verständnis für Systemarchitekturen, Datenflüsse, Schnittstellen und Datenmodelle
* Erfahrung im Reporting, insbesondere Risikoreports, Dashboards oder BI-Lösungen, sowie Kenntnisse in Power BI oder vergleichbaren Technologien sind vorteilhaft
* Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten, Entscheidungsstärke sowie eine strukturierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise
* Kommunikationsstärke, die Fähigkeit, komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich und adressatengerecht aufzubereiten und unterschiedliche Interessen zusammenzuführen
**Deine Benefits**
------------------
* Vergütung & Finanzen
 + Attraktives Gehalt (Tariflich)
 + 13. Monatsgehalt im Tarif
 + Betriebliche Altersvorsorge
 + Vermögenswirksame Leistungen
 + Essenszulage
* Work-Life-Balance & Flexibilität
 + 30 Tage Jahresurlaub und Bankfeiertage (24.12./31.12.)
 + Flexible Arbeitszeiten
 + Home-Office bzw. mobiles Arbeiten
* Gesundheit und Wohlbefinden
 + JobRad
 + pme-Familienservice
 + Moderne Hardware-Ausstattung
 + Medizinische Vorsorge und Bildschirmarbeitsplatzbrille
* Entwicklung & Community
 + Weiterbildungen
 + Karrieremöglichkeiten
 + Welcome-Veranstaltung
 + Events
**Dein Job?**
-------------
Wir freuen uns auf Deine aussagekräftige, digitale Bewerbung im **PDF-Format**, idealerweise bestehend aus Anschreiben, Lebenslauf und Zeugnissen.
Noch Fragen? Gerne beantwortet melanie.fiedler@s-kreditpartner.de diese per E-Mail.

title: Senior Project Manager (m/w/d) Data Center Electrification
description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 
 This position is for a permanent Senior Project Manager (f/m/d) within our Data Center business in the Grid Technology Substations Germany organization. The primary objective is to ensure the successful and professional execution of projects in the rapidly growing data center electrification market.
In this role, you will lead and further develop project management, engineering, and I&C teams responsible for large-scale substation projects. You will actively engage with customers, local system operators, permitting authorities, and subcontractors across Germany to ensure the achievement of project objectives.
Given the focus on large-scale project execution, the ideal candidate brings proven experience in leading project teams within complex turnkey projects, preferably in an international environment. While projects are primarily located in Germany and Central Europe, our customers are global players with expectations aligned to international standards and practices.
 How You’ll Make An Impact
 Lead large-scale projects supported by multiple sub-project managers, focusing on turnkey high-voltage substations for data centers and energy storage systems
 Represent Siemens Energy professionally towards internal and external stakeholders, ensuring alignment with business objectives
 Oversee project team capacity planning, workload distribution, performance management, and continuous team development
 Ensure adequate staffing of project teams in line with project requirements and organizational goals
 Ensure full compliance with applicable laws, permits, standards, and regulations, acting as a key technical authority within the project
 Contribute to the development of the data center business strategy in close collaboration with the sub-region leadership team
 What You Bring
 Master’s degree in engineering, science, or a related discipline, or an equivalent qualification combined with many years of relevant professional experience in project management
 Proven track record in the execution of large-scale turnkey projects, including solid experience in international project management
 Strong knowledge of international contract frameworks (e.g., FIDIC) or comparable standards
 Excellent interpersonal and leadership skills, including strong problem-solving abilities, strategic thinking, and clear communication
 Fluent in English and proficient in German, with a high level of initiative and strong communication capabilities
 About The Team
 Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.
 Who is Siemens Energy? 
 At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo
 Our Commitment to Diversity
 Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
 Rewards/Benefits
 In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
 We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
 We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
 The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
 In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical 
 We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.
https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

title: Senior Product Manager -Remote
description:
SeatPick is a profitable, fast-growing ticket comparison platform for live events. We help fans find the best tickets to sports, concerts and festivals by comparing listings from dozens of trusted resale sites in one place. More than 30 million fans use SeatPick every year, in 195 countries. We are a product-first, AI-first B2C company.
 The Role
 SeatPick is expanding into new verticals and business lines. title: Senior Product Manager, Cloud – Remote – FS470
description:
Description
 The Fresche Solutions professional services team is seeking a highly motivated and versatile product manager to join our team and set the long-term vision and product strategy for customer cloud experiences. You will lead the packaging, launch, and growth of our productized services portfolio. You will turn custom or repeatable infrastructure managed service capabilities into standardized, scalable, and repeatable offerings with clear scope, pricing, and delivery guidance. As Senior Product Manager for Cloud, you will own what our Cloud practice sells. You are comfortable with ambiguity, always willing to ask hard questions, push back when needed, and bring people along. Working across delivery, sales, marketing, operations, and engineering teams, you will balance customer value, margin, and operational efficiency across the portfolio. You will join a team of builders, product leaders, and end-to-end operators who set high standards, care deeply about customers, and invest in each other’s growth.
Key Job Responsibilities
Package and Price:
 Find the work we deliver again and again, document repeatable patterns, and turn it into reusable assets
 Work cross-functionally to ensure product decisions align with legal/regulatory obligations, customer needs requirements, and business growth & margin goals. 
 Design each offering as a module that combines with others into a larger comprehensive solution. 
 Take Offerings to Market:
 Map the customer journey and the strategic use cases we pursue based on differentiation. 
 Align Sales, Legal, Marketing, and delivery teams on one go-to-market plan for each offering. 
 Train sellers to lead and close deals with offerings. Join customer discovery and advisory calls to hear problems first-hand. 
 Own the Portfolio:
 Build your practice’s portfolio of productized services with supporting data. Find gaps worth filling. 
 Track each offering’s in-market performance. Improve weak offerings, and retire the ones that don’t earn their place. 
 Own the positioning, prioritization, and roadmap for your offerings, today and 2 to 3 years out. 
 What happens on a Tuesday
Here's a typical day into the role:
 In the morning: A Modernization account executive wants a Cloud managed services option for a deal closing this month. You find the tier that fits and check its delivery cost. 
 During late morning: You review a customer proposal for Cloud tiers and find where sellers still build custom quotes from components. 
 After lunch: You lead a portfolio review with the practice. You cover how published tiers perform, plus risks and customer signals on offerings in progress. 
 In the afternoon: You draft the PR/FAQ for a new CxO advisory offering, using competitor research and customer feedback. 
 At the end of the day: The executive team asks how much Cloud revenue came from other practices’ deals this quarter. You answer with data. 
 Basic Qualifications
 Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, analytics, mathematics, statistics, IT or equivalent
 5+ years in product management, or equivalent experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition in technical program management or operations roles. 
 Experience packaging a service, solution, or product, and taking it to market: value-based scope, price, positioning, ROI, and launch. 
 Experience defining product requirements, writing business needs documentation, and setting outcome-based success criteria that align development execution with measurable results. 
 Experience engaging with senior technical stakeholders and business leaders
 Uses AI tools in daily work for research, analysis, and writing. 
 Preferred Qualifications
 Master's degree in engineering, statistics, computer science, operations research, business analytics, information systems or equivalent. 
 Experience with cloud or hosting infrastructure, such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or IBM Power. 
 Experience with managed services, subscription pricing, and service level agreements. 
 Experience in at least one enterprise vertical: e.g. financial services, healthcare/life sciences, manufacturing, telecommunications, energy sector. 
 WHY JOIN FRESCHE? Fresche Solutions helps companies that run their business on IBM i modernize their applications, run them in the cloud, and get more from their data. We believe in leading our industry, we believe in innovation, we believe in delighting our customers, guaranteeing their success, and ensuring that 100% of our customers are referenceable.
At Fresche Solutions, we offer great work-life balance with flexible hours. You can work anywhere in North America… either from your home or in one of our offices… the decision is up to you. Our distinct company culture makes us a top employer, as well a premiere choice for our customers for the last eleven (11) consecutive years. We work hard to ensure that our values permeate the company and are reflected in everything we do. Whether it be in setting priorities, defining ideas, or carrying out processes, we are committed to ensuring that our values are manifested at all levels of our organization.
We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
